title: Friends don’t let friends feed their data to AI agents
slides: Why do friends warn you about AI agents?
They remember everything you say, forever
But the real leak is what they write down
Audit what your agent can read and store
Delete the memory before sharing your next chat
thread_text:
1. Why Friends Warn You

They've seen agents accidentally store passwords and personal details from chats, then expose them later.

2. They Never Forget

AI agents log every word you say to improve service, creating a permanent record you can't control.

3. The Real Leak

Agents often write down sensitive info like addresses or keys in logs that are poorly secured and easily accessed.

4. Audit Their Access

Regularly check what data your agent can read and store, and limit permissions to only what's necessary.

5. Delete Before Sharing

Clear your agent's memory before starting a new chat to prevent accidental leaks—do it now to protect your privacy.

instagram.caption:
Your AI agent remembers every word you type, forever—including the things you forgot you said.

It logs passwords and addresses in poorly secured files, then exposes them later.

The real leak isn't the chat itself. It's what the agent quietly writes down. 🚨

So audit what your agent can read and store, and limit permissions to the minimum.

Then wipe its memory before your next chat. 🧹

What's sitting in your agent's logs right now that you'd never say out loud? 👀
